title: Coordinate live accelerator memory headroom with model admission and control plane responsiveness
goal: Model admission uses an isolated AccelPool mock and hardcoded limits; lacks integration with measured accelerator headroom, out-of-memory reservation release on the production runtime path, and control plane responsiveness guarantees under concurrent load. Acceptance requires a test that exercises the production path, not the module in isolation: this task was filed with the vector's mastery test as its acceptance, and that test passes today because the module already satisfies its own semantics - which is why the task could be closed without the integration it asks for. The named test does not exist yet, and is the work.
